title: About me
lead: I'm chief of staff at RallyUp, where I run operations and clients for a LinkedIn content agency closing in on $1M ARR, and I write [The Draft](/#newsletter), a weekly letter on career, marketing and building an income on the internet.
ladder: I grew up in Mallorca and left at seventeen for the [University of York](https://www.york.ac.uk) to read business and management.

At eighteen I ran my first business, organising and selling event tickets to international students. It made $10,000. I spent it on a watch, which I would like to say taught me something about capital allocation.
In 2022 I joined [AlphaSights](https://www.alphasights.com) in London and finished ranked first in my cohort, at 117 percent of quota.

I spent the next two and a half years at [Synpulse](https://www.synpulse.com) doing management consulting. It is the part of the story where I learned how large organisations actually decide things, which turned out to matter more than I expected.
In 2025 I moved back to Spain to run partnerships at dCycle, a sustainability startup, and built a partner channel past €200,000 in recurring revenue.

At twenty-three I sent [one cold message](/resources/chief-of-staff-dm) to a founder I had never met. He replied in thirty minutes. I started fractionally, and I am now chief of staff at RallyUp on $100k plus equity.

RallyUp pivoted on the first of May with no demand at all. By August we had grown revenue thirty-seven times over, held client retention above ninety percent, and shipped more than 700 posts for leadership teams at [PandaDoc, Walnut, Anchor Browser and Andel](https://rallyup.team/case-studies/).
closing: Today I run RallyUp's operations from Mallorca, write The Draft every week, and train jiu-jitsu three times a week.
